gold: Kaposiform hemangioendothelioma (KHE) of the internal auditory canal

selector.rationale: The presence of a vascular lesion with low levels of mitotic activity, biphasic lesion composed of vascular nodules among spindle cells, and positive staining for CD34 and CD31 are more characteristic of Hemangioma.

rejected.label: Lymphangioma
rejected.why: Although the pattern is similar to lymphangiomatosis, the overall histopathological features and positive endothelial cell markers are more consistent with Hemangioma.
